d: How can India strengthen its position as a leading maritime power? In this exclusive conversation with Firstpost's Hem Kaur Saroya, Col. (Retd.) Douglas MacGregor, PhD, former Senior Advisor to the US Secretary of Defense, discusses India's strategic importance in the Indian Ocean. He argues that India should play a much bigger role in asserting its naval power and protecting its maritime interests. MacGregor also highlights India's standing as a major global power and explains why a stronger Indian naval presence is important in shaping the region's geopolitical future. Watch this video…
